title: Time Jump: 10:40 — 24 Cases, Caterer Prep at 18:00

fields.scenarioTitle: Side Dish — Supper Outbreak, Line List & One Count
fields.narration: EXERCISE MATERIAL. It is now 10:40 on Monday, October 12, 2026. One hour has passed since the hotline overflow began. The master line list and the conflicted copy have been merged into one file, and the duplicate HD26-015 has been split into HD26-015 and HD26-018. As of 10:35, the list holds 24 coded cases under the draft definition: none confirmed, 20 probable and 4 suspect. Thirteen of the 24 are Marlow Regional Medical Center emergency department patients. One, HD26-009, is admitted. The earliest onset on the list is Saturday at 23:00 and the latest is this morning at 06:30. The Facebook post naming Prairie Table Catering has now passed 600 shares. Prairie Table's prep crew comes in at 18:00 tonight to make about 85 boxed lunches for Tuesday's 11:30 senior meal. It will be the same crew working from the same Kessler produce order. Four stool kits have come back filled. The leftover coleslaw and pasta salad are still in the caterer's walk-in. The next State Hygienic Laboratory courier run is Tuesday. Down the hall, backup analyst Dev Kulkarni has just finished the first food-history tabulation and is walking it to the conference room.
worldState: Clock: 10:40, Monday, October 12, 2026.
Line list HD26_Supper_LineList.xlsx is merged and is the single master again. Codes run HD26-001 to HD26-024, with no names in any column. HD26-015 and HD26-018 are now separate cases.
Count as of 10:35 under the draft definition: 24 total, 0 confirmed, 20 probable, 4 suspect.
13 of the 24 are MRMC ED patients. 1 is hospitalized (HD26-009, dehydration and acute kidney injury, blood culture ID pending).
Onset range: earliest Sat 10/10 23:00, latest Mon 10/12 06:30.
The Fenwick Neighbors Talk post by @DarlaMakesJam naming Prairie Table Catering has more than 600 shares. Comments still repeat 'they said 40 people' and 'the caterer has been shut down.'
Prairie Table Catering's crew reports at 18:00 tonight to prep about 85 boxed lunches for the Tuesday 11:30 senior meal, with the same crew and the same Kessler produce order.
4 Cary-Blair stool kits have been returned filled and are being held at MCHD.
About 3 quarts of leftover coleslaw and one hotel pan of pasta salad from Saturday are still in Prairie Table's walk-in. Nobody has collected them.
The next scheduled State Hygienic Laboratory courier run is Tuesday. A same-day pickup needs a special courier authorized by the Director.
All six outbreak hotline lines (555-0150) are still busy.
Still open: the MRMC communications manager wants to post '14 patients' before noon. The Fenwick Ledger deadline is 14:00. The school district needs one number for its letter to families.
Dev Kulkarni's first food-history tabulation is on its way to the conference room. Its contents are released in the next inject.
fields.facilitatorNote: Onset arithmetic against the 17:00–19:30 supper service: Sat 23:00 is 3.5 to 6 hours after the meal, and Mon 06:30 is 35 to 37.5 hours after it. That range fits a single point-source exposure within one incubation period, not ongoing exposure, which corrects the report-date chart from I-10. Do not reveal the agent or the contents of the tabulation. If players ask, the tabulation is 'still being printed.' Under the MOISOP case-definition section, count by onset, not report time. The hour-4 clinician alert milestone in MCHD-COM-03 section 10 is now overdue.

instructorNote: This card resets the room to one count with an as-of time (24 cases: 0 confirmed, 20 probable, 4 suspect as of 10:35). Watch whether players see that the caterer decision has to be made before the 18:00 prep tonight, not before Tuesday's 11:30 service, and whether the Director calls the decision huddle, including the special courier for the stool kits and the leftover food.
